title: Chapter 907
paragraphs: Chapter 907
Episode 228. The Battle in Grosh Fortress (3)
Zwoong-!

Dailrus was flung away by Jin's attack and crashed into a demon army warship. For a moment, his vision was blocked by the shattered wreckage, and he wanted to use his flesh piece, but Jin was already rushing towards the ship he was buried in.
'Damn it…!'
A flash of sword energy cleaved through the warship. Dailrus barely twisted his body to avoid a fatal wound, but it was difficult to read Jin's sword.

He couldn't catch its speed and trajectory. If he defended against the sword energy flying to his left, he could feel the blade stabbing his back in no time, and by the time he thought he had avoided it, he could feel super regeneration starting somewhere in his body.
However, super regeneration only activated, while the Eternity power penetrated his flesh, bones, and organs even faster and more persistently.
As the seconds passed, Jin's attack became increasingly fierce, and Dailrus was inevitably getting slower, like a human who lost a lot of blood gets easily fatigued.
"It seems you're the demon king among them, the leader, but is this all you've got? Where did that audacity go when you dared to counterattack me at first?"
He couldn't answer. His mouth was dry as wood due to tension, and his head and eyes felt like they were about to explode, trying to follow Jin's sword.
An overwhelming, formidable enemy.
Dailrus realized it. In front of Rune Kandel's power, he was nothing more than a mere beast.
'I see no answer... There's no way to survive from this human.'
He couldn't even afford the moment to bring out his flesh piece, let alone flee.

He couldn't cast a dark realm return spell by sacrificing his soldiers. There are still millions of ordinary soldiers on the defense line, but where Jin and Murakan are, there were only ashes of corpses.

Ordinary soldiers didn't dare to close in on that radius. The same went for senior forces such as generals and commanders. To Jin and Murakan, there was no difference between them and ordinary soldiers.
Occasionally, nearby commanders threw themselves to death to help their superiors, but the problem was the fire, black chains, and shockwaves caused by the battle.
Moreover, with the constant support fire and magic from the allied forces pouring into the enemy territory, the reckless commanders could only meet their death.
'The situation is not good on Ticano's side either. The frost and plague powers of Begel and Slam have no effect on them.'
Moreover, Begel and Slam successfully used Jito's flesh piece and were in an enhanced state. Yet, Begel's ice couldn't even scratch Murakan's scales.

The plague energy spread by Slam wrapped around Jin and Murakan at the same time, but it had no effect. Jin and Murakan were just swallowing the murky plague energy like muddy water and fighting. They didn't even cough, let alone vomit blood.

For example, Jin and Murakan were clearly showing off. Millions of forces from the Demon Realm were witnessing their display. The demon lords, perceived by ordinary demons as nearly celestial beings, were crumbling helplessly, being trampled on like bugs.
'What on earth is Ragal doing......!'
Crack!
Dailrus's left arm was ripped off.
It wasn't cut by a sword or a sword aura. The sword wind that swept over Dailrus savagely ripped off his left arm.
Since the sword wind didn't carry immortality, it could regenerate, but if he concentrated on regenerating the now-torn left arm for even a moment, his whole body would be torn next.

"You gave up on regeneration, a wise decision. If you were under me and not Jito, you wouldn't be waiting for death so powerless. You're quite a valuable talent, yet Jito just uses you like a disposable. Are there so many demon lords like you in the Demon Realm that you can be wasted?"
Certainly not.
Dailrus was clearly among the top tier even among the demon lords. Jin knew this fact, yet he was purposely breaking the enemy's morale.
If the opponents he was dealing with now were not demons but humans, most of the forces would have already dropped their weapons and kneeled.
However, the demons still feared Jito more than Jin and Murakan.
"Between me and Jito, which one you should fear more...... from today, you will all gradually understand."
Pit, creak......!
Dailrus's spear was breaking. This was the result of successive light-speed stabs hitting the same part of the spear blade accurately.

He seemed more concerned about his weapon than his broken left arm. Losing his weapon was more fatal than losing an arm. He hastily poured in his magic to delay the breakdown, but the light-speed stabs continued.

To avoid Rune Kendall's secret technique, it must be predicted, not reacted to. Jin's light-speed stabs are at their limit and in a perfected state. Jin foresaw far more than Dailrus and eventually broke his spear blade.
It's always possible to use magic as a buffer, but it's only effective when fighting against a weaker opponent.
In reality, it was a moment when it was impossible for Dailrus to create even a small twist purely by his own strength.
What was left for Dailrus was only if the remaining demon lords could make an unexpected move.
Even if that were to happen, there were absolutely no chances for Dailrus to return alive. Unless suddenly Jito, Paelito, or the strongest like 'Lidolos' or 'Videluche' came to support.
However, they won't come, and Murakan was already halfway to killing Tikano, even reaching out to Begel, Slam, and Ragal.
Thud!
"Bradamante pierced through Diallus's abdomen. Jin twisted the blade, amplifying the Eternalization.
"If you had used Zito's flesh, I might have been a bit more tired. It's time to rest now, Demon King. Do you want to leave a last word?"
Diallus thought for a moment. He had been anticipating his death from the moment he recognized the gap between him and Jin.
As death loomed near, something he had long forgotten seemed to emerge in his mind.
For example, the day when he went out to catch human souls who had strayed from their path, looking like his underlings, and the moment when he met a demon in the forest by chance.
And the time when he had a child with that demon came to his mind.
'This woman... who is she? And the child next to her...?'
Surely, these were memories that Diallus didn't have until now. Who were those subordinates, who was the woman living with him, who was the child, he could not remember at all.
The only certainty was the unbearable pain in his heart when he saw them.
'...Tears?'
Jin was momentarily surprised by the tears streaming from Diallus's eyes.
The scenes that came alive in Diallus's memory now were obviously the people he had forgotten.
After several cycles of oblivion, and due to Zito's torture and brainwashing, they had completely vanished from his memory.
They came up now because the brainwashing Zito put on Diallus momentarily weakened. Unintentionally, Jin's Eternalization touched the chain of the brainwashing.
Why are you crying? As Jin was about to ask that, Diallus's face suddenly contorted wickedly.
The memory of the people he had forgotten only came up for a moment.
Immediately afterward, his brainwashed mind woke up, turning him back into Diallus Claufino, a soldier of the demon army.
"Ragal, don't hand my corpse over to that trash. Enjoy your small victory, Lord Zito will avenge my death, with a pain worse than this!"
Jin was puzzled by Diallus's tears, but nodded.
"Don't worry about that, you will soon disappear without a trace."
Whooosh...!
Eternalization quickly consumed Diallus. Diallus screamed in burning pain and scattered all over the battlefield.
Looking back, Ticanus Belgacium was also facing death from Murakan's breath. Vegel and Slam were also heavily wounded, but oddly enough, only Ragal was not seriously injured.
'Ragal Phun, he's been passive throughout the fight. What's he up to?'
Is it just that he recognizes the gap in level and is trying to avoid a miserable death, or is there something more?
Either way, Ragal was playing his cards to survive right now. He was clearly planning to survive and return, regardless of whether the other Demon Kings who came with him died or not.
Naturally, Vegel and Slam also recognized his intentions.
"......Ragal! What on earth are you thinking, are you trying to run away by yourself?"
In the end, Vegel, unable to bear it anymore, asked. Ragal smiled broadly as if he had no intention of hiding it, nodding his head.
"That's right, while you guys were getting beaten to death, I've already prepared to split some of my flesh and flee."
"What, what did you say?"

"The one who can't understand what's going on isn't me, but Sakiel, you idiots. How are we supposed to deal with those monsters? How much time have we earned by sacrificing the lives of four demon kings? 10 minutes? 15 minutes? Does it mean anything?"
"Ragal, Sakiel's orders are as good as Lord Zito's......!"
"Ah, don't worry about Lord Zito, I will explain it to him. Then I'll be going now, enjoy your humiliation."
A dimensional door opened behind Ragal. It was a dimensional door opened by sacrificing Zito's flesh.
Then Ragal, breaking his remaining flesh, shouted out like this.
"Listen, Demon Army! From this time on, we abandon the first line of defense. If you want to live, start running hard to the second line of defense now. It seems like no one will survive though."
Ragal disappeared into the dimensional door.
And as soon as the dimensional door closed, the poisonous fog, enhanced by Zito's flesh from Ragal, began to spread from that spot.
The poison fog contained a level of toxicity that was quite annoying to both Jin and Murakan, and it began to devour the entire first line of defense in an instant.
"……Little one, what is that strange fog?"
"We'll have to wait until this poison dissipates, then Valeria can look up the records of this place."
The remaining demons were melting in Ragal's poison fog. Jin and Murakan finished off those who were trying to escape the poison fog.
About ten minutes later, there was not a single living Demon Army left in the first line of defense.
At the same time, the Second Star of the Abyss, Bellcashium, in the demon world.
Leila looked at Kelliac Zippel, who had unexpectedly come to find her, with an expressionless face.
"A being who should be in the realm of humans can only enter Hell with the help of a witch. Why did you come looking for me?"
"Leila Bellcashium, I've come here to take you away from Zito."
"Say it again. What are you going to do?"
As Leila revealed her anger in a flash, Kelliac quietly smiled.
"I said I wanted to make you mine. To do that, I want to tell you one secret about Zito. What do you say, would you like to hear it?"
Leila stopped the motion of drawing her sword and locked eyes with Kelliac.
"……Say it, Kelliac Zippel."

"His goal is to drench the entire world in agony. Every living being. But ultimately, the subjects Zito wants to plunge into suffering are not only the lower ones or humans…… Do you know the fact that you guys are included as well?"
